summary.id: Memahami pengesaan Allah dalam keyakinan dan ibadah.
summary.en: Understanding Allah's oneness in belief and worship.

text.id: Tauhid berarti mengesakan Allah: meyakini bahwa Dia satu-satunya Tuhan dan mengarahkan seluruh ibadah hanya kepada-Nya tanpa sekutu.
text.en: Tawhid means affirming Allah's oneness: believing that He alone is God and directing every act of worship to Him without partners.

body.id: Doa, pengharapan, rasa takut dalam ibadah, dan bentuk pengabdian lainnya ditujukan kepada Allah semata.
body.en: Supplication, hope, worshipful fear, and other forms of devotion are directed to Allah alone.

label.en: I understand the basic meaning of tawhid.
